title: Walking around Busan bullet train station Korea Busan City ambience 4k
description: Busan station is the most beautiful train stop where you can watch the sea at the platform, the fastest way from Seoul to busan korea is the bullet train over 300km per hour, usually the price is about 45 bucks it takes 2 and 20 min from Seoul to korea about 380km distance. Busan is the 2nd largest city in korea, I hope you enjoy video what I recorded nearby busan station platform.
